source_cohort: Previously exposed 61024001..61024064 visitor-history RNG seeds, ORIGINAL post20 transplanted-source experiment, NOT new ecological histories.

genetic_composition.neutral_all: all three loci and allele origins/flags from neutral t20 source resample
genetic_composition.selected_all: all three loci and allele origins/flags from selected t20 source resample
genetic_composition.selected_assurance_only: matching and investment alleles/ancestry from neutral donor, entire assurance diploid allele pair/ancestry/flags from selected donor
genetic_composition.selected_nonassurance_only: both matching and investment diploid alleles/ancestry/flags from selected donor, entire assurance allele pair/ancestry/flags from neutral donor

future.ecological_visitor_history: exact same source visitor history years 20-79, original exposed IDs reused

quality_gates: Source neutral_all and selected_all baseline cells reproduce exactly original K8 15/36 and K48 41/49 whole-genome transplant source outcomes, no tolerance.
All four hybrid genotypes preserve each entire corresponding locus's two alleles, allele origins, mutation flags; unique current recipient IDs and birth year20.
Same original eight source-sampled recipient genotypes (before hybrid) and random demographic stream for all K and genotype composition conditions.
Do not condition post20 occupancy on future survival; donor eligibility based only on original both-surviving t20 statuses, 50/64.
No new genomic mutation, no allele-wise within-locus reshuffling, no new visitor RNG histories.
Report every hybrid condition, both K values, and all null/failed outcomes.

estimands.primary_decision: No new confirmatory primary permitted: all contrasts are post-outcome mechanistic descriptive; use conservative paired exact intervals as sensitivity only, avoid significance promotion.

limitations: Artificially mosaiced whole-locus genotypes combine individuals from two counterfactual genealogies; novel across-locus associations may result. This is a source-level intervention, not a natural Mendelian field cross.
Shapley allocation averages two intervention orders and sums to total, but neither share is a unique natural genetic mediation fraction.
Assurance diploid genotype differs in mean, within-locus variation and ancestral origins jointly, so this is not a pure mean-allele effect.
Original donor selection conditions on both source populations alive at t20; effects are not total survival from t0, and no independent ecological replications arise.
One whole-genotype resampling draw per original donor/history; resampling stochasticity is not a biological replicate.
Fixed-depression, zero-mutation model excludes mutational load and genetic meltdown; no evolutionary-suicide claim.
